title: FedEx Collaborates with Korea AEO Association (KAA) to Empower SMEs for the Year-End Peak
summary: KAA members to receive up to 60% discount on international shipping and dedicated customs clearance support
body_markdown:
**SEOUL, South Korea, November 19, 2026 —** Federal Express Corporation (FedEx), one of the world’s largest express transportation companies, announced a collaboration with Korea AEO Association (KAA) to strengthen the import and export capabilities and competitiveness of small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as they prepare for the year-end peak season.


Korean SMEs continue to show robust growth and resilience in global trade, with the Korea International Trade Association’s Export Business Survey Index (EBSI) stood at 111.3 for 2026 Q4, well above the 100 benchmark. SME exports reached USD 33.4 billion in 2026 Q3, up 8.8% year-over-year and a new quarterly record.1As pressures from rising international logistics costs, evolving trade regulations, and geopolitical tensions are expected to intensify,2 the collaboration is designed to help Korean SMEs navigate imports and exports more smoothly, enhance operational efficiency with greater value through the peak season and beyond.


Under the agreement, KAA members will receive up to 60% discount on FedEx international shipping services, including FedEx International Priority® Express, FedEx International Priority® and FedEx International Economy®, and gain access to digital tools such as FedEx Ship Manager, FedEx Import Tool and API solutions that automate and streamline customs clearance while improving visibility.


In addition, FedEx will offer customized customs clearance consulting sessions for KAA members, providing practical guidance on navigating complex clearance processes and market-specific regulations, helping them stay compliant and agile in a competitive trade environment.
